title: Omit the final proof query
statement: For a natural number $m$, define a map from optional queries whose addresses are either in a set of size $m+2$ or in a set of size $m+1$ to optional queries whose addresses are either in the same set of size $m+2$ or in a set of size $m$. It preserves absent queries and queries of the first kind, and for queries of the second kind it maps the final address to no query while retaining every earlier address.
